text: When considering whether the delivery fleet should switch to electric vans, it is crucial to evaluate the effectiveness of the new technology. A certified service network operating within ten miles of the customers can provide better fuel efficiency and reduce greenhouse gas emissions. This is especially beneficial in our market where noise is a significant concern. The quiet curbside branding opportunity is unique to our area, allowing for a more streamlined experience for customers. Additionally, the model shows that a fuel-efficient conversion can halve fuel spend after a short period. These factors outweigh any potential concerns about the initial investment in electric vans. In conclusion, the delivery fleet should consider switching to electric vans, especially in areas with these advantages.
